forever_doc: Reversal exits after the first live trade
how: Every night on your PC (after the data comes in) the Lab re-tests each idea on the real Zlarior and ATLAS backtests, all periods, costs in.
An idea must make more $ in Jan-Jun AND Jul-Oct, keep 2-4 trades a week, not raise eval fails, and beat random luck (with a stricter bar the more ideas we test).
Then it trades on paper (shadow) for 4 weeks on days it has never seen. Still not losing = READY TO ADOPT: you get one push. Nothing changes until you say yes.
What helps Zlarior is tried on ATLAS and the other way round. Ideas already rejected are never re-run.
